description: Mutation sweep over the t0 feature contract -- the module whose job is that no feature may be computed from anything after t0. Every mutant either admits a look into the future, lets an identity become a predictor, or accepts a state the contract refuses. PLAN.md has claimed 31/31 for this since before sweeps were reproducible.

mutants.name: an observation after t0 is accepted
the after-t0 boundary made inclusive
t0 need not be inside the launch transaction
the decision state itself may be missing
t0 presence recorded without checking the key
an empty observation list is accepted
a string may appear in a feature block
a non-integer feature is accepted
mutants.old: if value is not None and not isinstance(value, (int, bool)):

mutants.name: the feature block need not match the contract
the grouping block need not match the contract
an identity may also be a feature
create need not be a mapping
a string is accepted as observations
a missing required field is tolerated
an unknown program version is treated as supported
an unsupported program version is accepted
a curve outside its regime is accepted
the buy-formula floor is not applied at the veto site
the upper bound of the floor is dropped
the floor accepts a non-integer
mutants.old: if not isinstance(tokens_out, int) or isinstance(tokens_out, bool):

expected_survivors_note: None expected. Every feature record in this project rests on these guards; one that no test can distinguish from its absence would mean the leakage claim is unverified rather than verified.
